title: The Wedding Singer
about: A heartbroken 1985 wedding singer falls for a waitress who's about to marry the wrong guy.
cue: Serve the mains when Grandma Rosie hands Robbie her meatballs.

    StartersCocktail franks in puff pastryCocktail franks wrapped in puff pastry strips and bakedHow to make it24 cocktail franks2 sheets of puff pastry, thawed1 egg, beaten3 tbsp yellow mustard100ml tomato sauceSimmer the franks briefly and drain well.Cut the pastry into strips and roll one around each frank.Brush with beaten egg and bake at 200°C until golden.Serve with mustard and tomato sauce.Eighties cheese ballCheddar, cream cheese and spring onion rolled in walnuts, with crackersHow to make it200g cheddar, grated250g cream cheese2 spring onions100g walnuts, chopped1 box water crackersMix the cheddar, cream cheese and sliced spring onion.Shape into one big ball and roll in the walnuts.Chill until firm.Serve with crackers.Vegas flight honey peanut brittleThe flight to Las VegasHow to make itAs written, serves 4Salted roasted peanuts set in a golden honey toffee with a little butter and bicarb so it shatters, broken into shards and bagged like airline snacks.Line a tray with baking paper.Heat 200g caster sugar, 60ml honey and 60ml water in a saucepan, stirring until dissolved, then boil without stirring until light golden, about 8 minutes.Stir in 200g salted roasted peanuts and 20g butter and cook 1 to 2 minutes more until amber.Take off the heat, stir in half a teaspoon bicarb and pour onto the tray.Cool 30 minutes, then smash into shards and bag up.Cob loaf spinach dipJulia Gulia? Roll into balls.Brown the meatballs in the oil.Add the tomatoes and simmer.Cook the spaghetti and serve with the meatballs on top.Reception stuffed chicken and lemon butterThe catering at every weddingHow to make itAs written, serves 4Chicken breasts stuffed with spinach and ricotta, roasted at 200°C for 20 minutes, with roast potatoes and beans.Mix 200g ricotta with 60g chopped baby spinach, 30g grated parmesan, lemon zest and pepper.Cut a pocket into the side of 4 chicken breasts and stuff.Sear in oil 3 minutes a side, then roast at 200°C for 20 minutes.Roast 800g halved chat potatoes in oil at 200°C for 40 minutes.Steam 2 bunches green beans.Melt 60g butter with the juice of 1 lemon and parsley and spoon over the sliced chicken.SweetsJam and buttercream layer cakeButter sponge layers with strawberry jam, iced white with buttercreamHow to make it250g self-raising flour250g butter, softened, for the cake250g caster sugar4 eggs150g strawberry jam150g butter, softened, for the buttercream300g icing sugar2 tbsp silver cachousBeat the butter and sugar, add the eggs, then fold in the flour.
